Buff.DisplayText: Blood: This Docent converts a portion of the wood and metal structure of the Warforged to living flesh. The Warforged will benefit more from positive energy healing such as cure spells and potions (+20 Positive Healing Amplification) but will also be more subject to critical hits (-10% fortification ).
Crown of Summer: You have a +15 Positive Healing Amplification, and you gain 10 Melee Power and 5 Ranged Power (all enhancement bonus ).
%b1 Healing Amplification %v1: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by %v1 (%b1 bonus ). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
%b1 Repair Amplification %v1: This effect amplifies all incoming repair energy healing by %v1 (%b1 bonus ). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.

Rock Shattering: When striking stone-like creatures (such as gargoyles and earth elementals ) or creatures that have been turned to stone, there is a chance this weapon will instantly shatter and destroy the target.
